windows_state_replace.known: The Windows branch removes the previous state file before renaming the replacement.
windows_state_replace.hypothesis: A process or machine failure in that interval can leave no state file and lose saved ownership/receipts.
windows_state_replace.next_experiment: On a Windows VM, stop at that exact interval and restart; inspect ownership and same-ID behavior without provider tasks.

publish_before_verify.known: The workflow pushes the version and latest container tags before the published-image smoke check; native release assets depend on that check.
publish_before_verify.hypothesis: A failed post-push check leaves newly advanced container tags without a completed native release.
publish_before_verify.next_experiment: Rehearse failure after push in a disposable registry/workflow stub; inspect tags and release state. Do not publish public artifacts.
